The country and number type must be enabled by the platform admin; countries with regulatory requirements additionally need an approved regulatory bundle on file. **Required scope:** `phone_numbers:read` (keys without scope restrictions have full access).
Seconds after VAD detects speech with no: Seconds after VAD detects speech with no STT transcript before asking the caller to repeat. null disables.
Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: u: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
Secret used to sign variable webhook req: Secret used to sign variable webhook requests (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, sent as `X-Famulor-Signature: sha256=<hex>`). Write-only: never returned. Null clears it. Keep this value private.
Self-inspection of the calling API key:: Self-inspection of the calling API key: key metadata, workspace (tenant), active plan, effective limits, feature toggles, and Assistant engine-mode availability (`-1` = unlimited, `0` = disabled). No scope required — any valid key works.
Send an outbound SMS from a workspace ph: Send an outbound SMS from a workspace phone number that has outbound SMS enabled (platform marketplace or Twilio BYOC). US 10DLC senders must be registered with an approved A2P campaign in Twilio. Platform numbers charge SMS credits including carrier pass-through; BYOC charges only the platform SMS fee (customer pays Twilio carrier cost). **Required scope:** `phone_numbers:write`.
Set to `library` to list official pre-wr: Set to `library` to list official pre-written utility templates.
Set true to book outside the event type': Set true to book outside the event type's open times (staff override). Any future time within the next 2 years is accepted; the time must not overlap another confirmed booking of the same event type. Guests on the public booking page only ever see open times.
Sets the campaign to `running` and trigg: Sets the campaign to `running` and triggers the first dialer wave immediately; subsequent waves run on a schedule. Calling windows, DNC list and concurrency are enforced by the dialer. **Required scope:** `campaigns:write` (keys without scope restrictions have full access).
Sort newest first by creation time (defa: Sort newest first by creation time (default) or latest update. Use `updated_at` when polling completed calls so older calls that finish later appear in the recent page.
Speaker-boost override. Send null to use: Speaker-boost override. Send null to use the voice-provider default.
Speech-recognition glossary for customer: Speech-recognition glossary for customer, product, and proper names. Plan-gated.
Start of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD); de: Start of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD); default today.
Start time in ISO 8601 UTC — must be a v: Start time in ISO 8601 UTC — must be a value returned by List free slots, unless allow_outside_availability is set.
Starts a payment-confirmed marketplace p: Starts a payment-confirmed marketplace purchase. The response is pending and includes `checkout_url`. Open this URL to review and confirm payment; it may open an authenticated in-app checkout or a hosted payment page. Routing and call access are provisioned only after verified payment. Failed, expired, or unpaid purchases release the held number. Requires a user-scoped API key. Pick a number from `GET /phone-numbers/available` first and pass its short-lived `purchase_token` unchanged. **Required scope:** `phone_numbers:write`.
The exact E.164 number returned by `GET: The exact E.164 number returned by `GET /phone-numbers/available`.
The short-lived token returned with the: The short-lived token returned with the exact number by `GET /phone-numbers/available`; pass it unchanged. Required for workspaces that buy numbers from a reseller. Otherwise optional, but when sent it must match the number, country and type.
Time format used in the invitee's confir: Time format used in the invitee's confirmation email; default 24h.
Triggers for new activity in the unified: Triggers for new activity in the unified conversation history, including calls, messaging and email. A conversation can emit again when its last activity changes.
Triggers once when a call completes afte: Triggers once when a call completes after the flow is enabled. Polls updated calls so calls created earlier can still finish later.
Triggers once when a messaging or email: Triggers once when a messaging or email conversation first appears completed after enabling the flow. Reads the completed history; existing completed conversations are skipped.
Triggers when a campaign is created in t: Triggers when a campaign is created in the workspace.
Triggers when a lead is added to the sel: Triggers when a lead is added to the selected campaign.
Triggers when a new Audience contact is: Triggers when a new Audience contact is created in the workspace.
Triggers when a new call is created in t: Triggers when a new call is created in the workspace.
Triggers when a new inbound call is crea: Triggers when a new inbound call is created. This event does not provide synchronous caller-variable enrichment.
Triggers when an assistant is created in: Triggers when an assistant is created in the workspace.
Turns on platform-managed model fallback: Turns on platform-managed model fallbacks, so a call continues on a backup model if a speech or language model fails. Must be a boolean. Switching it on requires Fallbacks & Guardrails; otherwise the request fails with HTTP 403.
Unanswered idle check-ins before the ass: Unanswered idle check-ins before the assistant says goodbye and ends the call (1–10, default 2).
Updates name, phone, email, tags, or use: Updates name, phone, email, tags, or user-managed custom fields. System variables and channel identities are read-only. **Required scope:** `leads:write`.
Use the resource UUID from this workspac: Use the resource UUID from this workspace.
Versioned manual response instructions f: Versioned manual response instructions for exact output channels. Omit a channel key to use Automatic. Manual instructions supplement and never replace safety, language, tool, or delivery rules. Requires the workspace's Manual channel responses feature.
Voice similarity override. Send null to: Voice similarity override. Send null to use the voice-provider default.
Voice stability override. Send null to u: Voice stability override. Send null to use the voice-provider default.
Voice-detection threshold. Null uses the: Voice-detection threshold. Null uses the effective engine default: 0.50 for pipeline and adaptive voice detection, 0.50 for web server VAD, and 0.70 for phone server VAD. This detects speech; it does not filter audio.
Voice-style exaggeration override. Send: Voice-style exaggeration override. Send null to use the voice-provider default.
What a direct outbound call does at a de: What a direct outbound call does at a detected mailbox: `true` = speak `voicemail_message`, then hang up; `false` = hang up without a message. Takes effect while `amd_enabled` is on. Campaign calls use the campaign's voicemail settings.
What happens when the caller declines co: What happens when the caller declines consent: `no_recording` continues the call without recording, `hangup` says a farewell and ends the call.
When greeting_mode is user_speaks_first:: When greeting_mode is user_speaks_first: after ai_entry_timeout_sec of initial silence, the assistant speaks (static or dynamic). Default false.
When true, apply `pii_redaction` entity: When true, apply `pii_redaction` entity filters to stored transcripts.
When true, only contacts on the Do-Not-C: When true, only contacts on the Do-Not-Call list are returned. When false, contacts on that list are excluded.
When true, the caller may barge in durin: When true, the caller may barge in during the opening greeting (first message / audio / silence fallback). Default false = play greeting uninterrupted. Separate from allow_interruptions (rest of the call).
Whether audio recording is enabled for c: Whether audio recording is enabled for calls handled by this assistant. In PATCH and PUT requests, omitting this field leaves the existing setting unchanged. Saving an explicit boolean (`true` or `false`) updates the setting. Recording calls is independent of Loop recording and voicemail recording; see `/assistants/conversation-quality#consent` for caller consent rules and `/billing/minutes#call-recording` for recording billing.
Workspace phone number this assistant ca: Workspace phone number this assistant calls from on outbound calls (an `id` from `GET /phone-numbers`). Several assistants can share one number. A `phone_number_id` passed when starting a call takes precedence. A number from another workspace or a released number returns HTTP 404. Null clears it. Use the resource UUID from this workspace.
`all` is an immutable compatibility stat: `all` is an immutable compatibility state for an assistant that already had unrestricted contact-field access. Creating with `all` or changing `selected` to `all` returns HTTP 400. `selected` exposes only explicit `source: lead` definitions.
`inherit` follows the workspace memory d: `inherit` follows the workspace memory default; `on`/`off` override it.
`workspace` = one summary shared across: `workspace` = one summary shared across assistants; `assistant` = one summary private to this assistant; `both` = two complete summaries, one shared and one assistant-private.
iOS/Android Call Screen Handling. Mirror: iOS/Android Call Screen Handling. Mirrored into flow_json.pre_call when a flow exists.
none = do not deliver; custom = POST the: none = do not deliver; custom = POST the assistant webhook URL after the call; automation = deliver through the bound automation.
